tracks.title: Sales Rep
tracks.description: Book Sales Orders from the field sales portal, save orders as pending, and deal with credit and stock warnings.

tracks.title: Store Keeper & Delivery
tracks.description: Create Delivery Notes from Sales Orders in Desk, pick up and deliver them in the delivery portal, and handle partial deliveries.

tracks.title: Sales Manager
tracks.description: Watch the order book in the DMS reports, fix an order that was delivered without an invoice, and record a customer's payment in Desk.

scenarios.title: Book a Standard Sales Order
scenarios.description: Pick a customer, add items, apply a discount and submit the order. Then find it in Order History.

steps.title: Your sales dashboard
steps.body: This is the Sales Rep home page (/sales-home). The cards show today's sales and the orders you created. You only ever see your own orders.

steps.title: Open Customers
steps.body: Every order starts with a customer. Click Customers in the sidebar.
steps.hint: It is the second link in the left sidebar.

steps.title: Search for the customer
steps.body: Type Gulf to find Gulf Office Supplies. You can search by name, ID or mobile number.

steps.title: Open the customer
steps.body: Click the Gulf Office Supplies card to see its details, credit and addresses.

steps.title: Start a new order
steps.body: Click New Order. The order form opens with this customer already filled in.

steps.title: Check the address
steps.body: The billing address comes from the customer. The shipping address is the same as billing unless you untick Same as Billing Address.

steps.title: Choose the warehouse
steps.body: Select Main Store - LS. The stock shown on each item is for the warehouse you pick, and the order ships from there.
steps.hint: The Warehouse select is under the categories on the left.

steps.title: Add a pen
steps.body: Click Add on Signature Blue Ballpoint Pen. It goes into the order summary on the right.

steps.title: Set the quantity
steps.body: The customer wants 50 pens. Change the quantity in the order summary to 50.

steps.title: Add a journal
steps.body: Also add one Leather Journal A5.

steps.title: Choose a discount type
steps.body: Discounts are optional. Choose Percentage to give the customer a percentage off the whole order.

steps.title: Enter the discount
steps.body: Enter 5 for a 5% discount.

steps.title: Review the totals
steps.body: Check the Subtotal, the Discount and the Grand total before you submit. Tax is added on the real system.

steps.title: Set the delivery date
steps.body: Pick a delivery date two days from today. It can't be before the order date.

steps.title: Submit the order
steps.body: Click Submit Sales Order.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Submitting commits stock and can't be undone, so the portal asks you to confirm. Click Submit.

steps.title: Order submitted
steps.body: The order is booked and shows in the store keeper's Sales Order list. Click OK.

steps.title: Open Order History
steps.body: After submitting you are back on the customer. Click Order History to find your order.

steps.title: Your order
steps.body: Here is your order with status To Deliver and Bill. Next, the store keeper makes the draft Sales Invoice and the Delivery Note in Desk, and a delivery partner delivers it. Well done!

scenarios.title: Save as Pending and Submit Later
scenarios.description: The customer isn't ready to confirm. Save the order as pending, change it later from Pending Orders, then submit it.

steps.title: Start a new order
steps.body: Click New Order in the sidebar. It opens the customer list, because every order needs a customer first.

steps.title: Pick the customer
steps.body: Open Corniche Corporate Services.

steps.title: New order for this customer
steps.body: Click New Order.

steps.title: Choose the warehouse
steps.body: Select Main Store - LS.

steps.title: Add copy paper
steps.body: Add A4 Copy Paper (Ream).

steps.title: Set the quantity
steps.body: Change the quantity to 20.

steps.title: Save as pending
steps.body: The customer wants to check the quantity with their office. Instead of submitting, click Save. This keeps the order as a draft.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Click Save. A pending order doesn't reserve stock and isn't sent to the warehouse.

steps.title: Saved
steps.body: Click OK. The portal takes you to Pending Orders.

steps.title: Your pending order
steps.body: Your draft is listed here. It stays here until you submit or discard it.

steps.title: Reopen the order
steps.body: The customer called back. Open Select Action on your order and choose Reopen to change it.
steps.hint: Submit would book it as it is, and Discard would delete it. Choose Reopen.

steps.title: Change the quantity
steps.body: They now want 30 reams. Change the quantity to 30.

steps.title: Add a stapler
steps.body: They also want a Heavy Duty Stapler. Add it.

steps.title: Submit the order
steps.body: Now the customer has confirmed. Click Submit Sales Order.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Click Submit.

steps.title: Submitted
steps.body: The same order was submitted, so no duplicate was created. Click OK.

steps.title: Check Pending Orders
steps.body: Open Pending Orders again.

steps.title: Gone from pending
steps.body: The order isn't pending any more. It is in Order History now. Tip: if nothing needs to change, choose Submit in Select Action to submit a pending order straight from this list.

scenarios.title: Credit Limit Warning
scenarios.description: The customer has little credit left. See the warning, see why submit is blocked, and reduce the order so it fits.

steps.title: Open Customers
steps.body: Click Customers.

steps.title: Open Al Noor Trading
steps.body: Open Al Noor Trading.

steps.title: Check the credit
steps.body: The credit limit is QAR 5,000 and QAR 4,200 is still unpaid. That leaves only QAR 800 of available credit. Check this before you promise a big order.

steps.title: Start the order
steps.body: Click New Order.

steps.title: Choose the warehouse
steps.body: Select Main Store - LS.

steps.title: Add fountain pens
steps.body: The customer asks for fountain pens. Add Classic Fountain Pen (QAR 185 each).

steps.title: Ask for 6 pens
steps.body: They want 6. Change the quantity to 6.

steps.title: The credit warning
steps.body: 6 × 185 = QAR 1,110, which is more than the QAR 800 available. The order summary shows Order exceeds available credit.

steps.title: Try to submit
steps.body: Click Submit Sales Order to see what happens.

steps.title: Blocked
steps.body: The portal blocks orders over the available credit. Either the customer pays their outstanding balance first, or the order is reduced. Click OK.

steps.title: Reduce the order
steps.body: The customer agrees to take 4 now (QAR 740). Change the quantity to 4. The warning goes away.
steps.hint: Any quantity of 4 or less fits within QAR 800.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Click Submit Sales Order.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Click Submit.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: The order is within credit and has been submitted. Tell your manager about the rest of the order, so it can be booked once the customer pays. Click OK.

scenarios.title: Not Enough Stock
scenarios.description: The chosen warehouse doesn't have enough stock. Read the error and ship from another warehouse.

steps.title: Open Customers
steps.body: Click Customers.

steps.title: Open Gulf Office Supplies
steps.body: Open Gulf Office Supplies.

steps.title: Start the order
steps.body: Click New Order.

steps.title: Choose Main Store
steps.body: Select Main Store - LS.

steps.title: Check the stock
steps.body: Look at Executive Desk Organizer. The card shows only 3 in stock at Main Store.

steps.title: Add the organizer
steps.body: Click Add.

steps.title: Ask for 5
steps.body: The customer wants 5. Change the quantity to 5.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Click Submit Sales Order.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Click Submit.

steps.title: Insufficient stock
steps.body: The system checks stock when you submit and blocks the order: 5 requested, 3 available. Nothing was booked. Click OK.

steps.title: Ship from the Showroom
steps.body: The Showroom - LS has 6 in stock. Change the warehouse to Showroom. The stock on the item cards updates.

steps.title: Submit again
steps.body: Click Submit Sales Order.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Click Submit.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Booked from the Showroom. If no warehouse has enough stock, book what's available and tell the customer when the rest will come. Click OK.

scenarios.title: Create a Delivery Note in Desk
scenarios.description: As the store keeper, make a draft Sales Invoice from a submitted Sales Order, then a draft Delivery Note for the delivery partners to pick up.

steps.title: Sales Orders to deliver
steps.body: You are the store keeper. This is the Sales Order list in Desk (Selling ▸ Sales Order). Orders that still need goods sent show To Deliver and Bill, and the % Delivered bar is empty.

steps.title: Open the Sales Order
steps.body: Open SAL-ORD-2026-00101 for Gulf Office Supplies.

steps.title: Check the items
steps.body: The order is for 100 notebooks and 20 packs of gel pens, shipped from Main Store. To Deliver and Bill means nothing is delivered or invoiced yet.

steps.title: Open the Create menu
steps.body: First you make the Sales Invoice. Click Create.

steps.title: Create the Sales Invoice
steps.body: Choose Sales Invoice.

steps.title: Same as the order
steps.body: ERPNext copied the order: the same items, quantities and rates. Leave the quantities as they are.

steps.title: Save as draft
steps.body: Click Save (or press Ctrl+S).

steps.title: A draft invoice
steps.body: The invoice is saved as Draft ACC-SINV-2026-00001. Don't submit it. When the delivery partner submits the Delivery Note, the invoice quantities are set to what was delivered, and it is submitted automatically once everything is delivered.

steps.title: Open Connections
steps.body: Now go back to the Sales Order from the invoice. Click the Connections tab: it lists every document linked to this invoice.

steps.title: Back to the Sales Order
steps.body: Under Reference ▸ Sales Order, click SAL-ORD-2026-00101 to open the order again.
steps.hint: The Sales Order link is in the Reference column of the Connections tab.

steps.title: The order's Connections
steps.body: You are back on the Sales Order. Click its Connections tab.

steps.title: The invoice is linked
steps.body: The draft invoice ACC-SINV-2026-00001 is now linked to this order under Sales Invoice. The Delivery Note you make next will show up here too.

steps.title: Open the Create menu
steps.body: Now the Delivery Note. Click Create.

steps.title: Create the Delivery Note
steps.body: Choose Delivery Note.

steps.title: What was copied
steps.body: ERPNext copied every item still to deliver, linked to the Sales Order. Change a quantity only if you are sending less than ordered.

steps.title: The source warehouse
steps.body: The goods leave from this warehouse. It comes from the Sales Order. Change it only if you pick the goods somewhere else.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Click Save.

steps.title: Ready for the drivers
steps.body: Saved as Draft MAT-DN-2026-00001. Don't submit it and don't assign it here. The delivery partners pick it up themselves in the delivery portal under Delivery Assign, and submit it after the delivery with proof.

scenarios.title: Pick Up and Deliver an Order
scenarios.description: As the delivery partner, pick up an unassigned Delivery Note, add proof of delivery and submit it. The invoice is completed automatically.

steps.title: Your delivery dashboard
steps.body: You are the delivery partner. Pending counts the notes assigned to you. Open Deliveries counts the notes nobody has picked up yet.

steps.title: Open Delivery Assign
steps.body: Click Delivery Assign in the sidebar.

steps.title: Unassigned deliveries
steps.body: The store keeper saved MAT-DN-2026-00001 for Gulf Office Supplies without assigning it. Any driver can pick it up here.

steps.title: Pick it up
steps.body: Click Assign to Me.

steps.title: It's yours
steps.body: The note moved to My Assigned Deliveries. If you can't make the delivery, Unassign hands it back to the other drivers.

steps.title: Open Pending Deliveries
steps.body: Click Pending Deliveries.

steps.title: Open the delivery
steps.body: Open the card for MAT-DN-2026-00001.

steps.title: Customer and address
steps.body: Here are the phone number and the delivery address. Ordered, Delivered and Remaining update as you change quantities.

steps.title: Check the items
steps.body: Delivered starts at the full quantity. The customer accepted everything, so leave the quantities as they are.

steps.title: Try to submit
steps.body: Click Submit Delivery to see what happens without proof.

steps.title: Add proof
steps.body: Proof of delivery is required. Click Camera to take a photo of the signed note or of the goods at the door.

steps.title: Add a remark
steps.body: Type who received the goods, for example Received by the store manager.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Click Submit Delivery.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Submitting can't be undone. Click OK.

steps.title: Delivered
steps.body: Done. Read the note on the screen: because everything was delivered, the draft Sales Invoice was filled in and submitted automatically, and the Sales Order is Completed.

steps.title: Back to your deliveries
steps.body: Click Back to Deliveries.

steps.title: Completed deliveries
steps.body: Submitted notes are listed here and are read-only.

scenarios.title: Partial Delivery
scenarios.description: The customer accepts only part of the goods. Deliver what was accepted, then the store keeper makes a Delivery Note for the rest.

steps.title: Open Pending Deliveries
steps.body: You are the delivery partner. You already picked up MAT-DN-2026-00001 under Delivery Assign. Click Pending Deliveries.

steps.title: Change the quantity
steps.body: 5 packs of gel pens are damaged and the customer refuses them. Change Gel Pen Black to 15. You can also use the − button.

steps.title: Partial delivery
steps.body: The item shows Partial Delivery. You can't deliver more than ordered: the portal blocks it.

steps.title: Remaining
steps.body: Remaining shows the 5 packs that still have to be delivered.

steps.title: Add proof
steps.body: Click Photo / Gallery to attach a photo.

steps.title: Explain why
steps.body: Write why the quantity is lower, so the office knows what happened.
steps.auto_value: 5 packs of gel pens damaged, customer refused them

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Click Submit Delivery.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Click OK.

steps.title: The invoice waits
steps.body: Read the note: the draft Sales Invoice now holds the delivered quantities (15 packs instead of 20) but stays a draft, because part of the order is still to deliver.

steps.title: Back at the office
steps.body: Now you are the store keeper again. The order still shows To Deliver and Bill. Open it.

steps.title: Open the gel pen row
steps.body: To see what was delivered, open the Gel Pen row: click the ✏️ pencil at the end of the row.

steps.title: Delivered so far
steps.body: Delivered Qty is 15 of 20. ERPNext tracks this per item from the submitted Delivery Notes.

steps.title: Open the Create menu
steps.body: Click Create.

steps.title: A note for the rest
steps.body: Choose Delivery Note.

steps.title: Only what is left
steps.body: ERPNext copied only the 5 packs still to deliver.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Click Save.

steps.title: Ready for a driver
steps.body: MAT-DN-2026-00002 is a draft for the remaining 5 packs. A driver picks it up under Delivery Assign. When it is delivered, the draft invoice is submitted and the Sales Order becomes Completed.

scenarios.title: Check the Order Book
scenarios.description: Use the Sales Order Status report in DMS to see which orders are waiting for delivery, which are overdue, and what a customer's order looks like.

steps.title: The summary cards
steps.body: This is Sales Order Status in the DMS app (/dms). There is one row per submitted Sales Order, and each card counts the orders in one state.

steps.title: Orders waiting for delivery
steps.body: Click the Pending Delivery card. Clicking a card filters the table to those orders.

steps.title: Partly delivered
steps.body: SAL-ORD-2026-00100 is Partly Delivered. The customer took 20 of 30 notebooks, so Pending Delivery Qty shows 10.

steps.title: Late deliveries
steps.body: Now click Overdue Deliveries.

steps.title: Days overdue
steps.body: Pearl School's order was due 8 days ago and nothing has left the store. Days Overdue counts from the expected delivery date. Follow this up with the store keeper.

steps.title: Back to all orders
steps.body: Click Total Sales Orders to clear the card filter.

steps.title: Find a customer
steps.body: Gulf Office Supplies calls about their order. Click the Customer filter.

steps.title: Pick the customer
steps.body: Choose Gulf Office Supplies. You can also type part of the name to narrow the list.

steps.title: Their orders
steps.body: Gulf Office Supplies has two orders. SAL-ORD-2026-00101 is not delivered yet. SAL-ORD-2026-00097 was delivered but has no invoice. The next scenario fixes that one.

steps.title: Linked documents
steps.body: In the Sales Invoices column of SAL-ORD-2026-00101, click the ⓘ icon.

steps.title: The draft invoice
steps.body: The store keeper saved ACC-SINV-2026-00004 as a Draft. It has no outstanding amount yet: it is submitted automatically when the goods are delivered.

steps.title: Close
steps.body: Close the dialog.

steps.title: Open the order
steps.body: Click SAL-ORD-2026-00101. On the real site, the order opens in Desk in a new browser tab.

steps.title: Its Connections
steps.body: Click the Connections tab.

steps.title: Same invoice
steps.body: The same draft invoice is linked here. You checked the order without changing anything: the report is the quicker way to see every order at once.

scenarios.title: Invoice a Delivered Order
scenarios.description: An order was delivered before anyone made its draft invoice, so nothing was billed. Find it in the report and submit its Sales Invoice from Desk.

steps.title: Filter by fulfilment
steps.body: In Fulfilment Status, choose Delivered – Invoice Pending.

steps.title: Not invoiced
steps.body: SAL-ORD-2026-00097 is delivered but Not Invoiced. The store keeper didn't save a draft invoice before the delivery, so the Delivery Note had no invoice to submit. The customer hasn't been billed.

steps.title: Open the order
steps.body: Click SAL-ORD-2026-00097 to open it in Desk.

steps.title: To Bill
steps.body: ERPNext shows To Bill: everything is delivered, nothing is billed.

steps.title: Open the Create menu
steps.body: Click Create.

steps.title: Create the invoice
steps.body: Choose Sales Invoice.

steps.title: Delivered quantities
steps.body: The invoice has the order's quantities: 30 reams and 4 staplers, all of them delivered.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Click Save.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Normally you leave the invoice as a draft. Here everything is already delivered, so submit it now: click Submit.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Click Yes.

steps.title: Unpaid
steps.body: The invoice is Unpaid with QAR 980.00 outstanding. Gulf Office Supplies' balance in Customer Balance went up by the same amount.

steps.title: Its Connections
steps.body: Click the Connections tab.

steps.title: Back to the order
steps.body: Click SAL-ORD-2026-00097 under Sales Order.

steps.title: Completed
steps.body: The order is now Completed: delivered and billed.

steps.title: Back in the report
steps.body: Back in DMS, the order no longer matches the filter. Click Total Sales Orders to show every order.

steps.title: Fully Completed
steps.body: SAL-ORD-2026-00097 is Fully Completed.

scenarios.title: Collect a Payment
scenarios.description: A customer pays an invoice by bank transfer. Record the Payment Entry in Desk and see their balance go down in DMS.

steps.title: What the customer owes
steps.body: This is Customer Balance in DMS. Corniche Corporate Services owes QAR 3,500.00. They tell you they transferred QAR 1,510.00 for invoice ACC-SINV-2026-00001.

steps.title: Open the invoice
steps.body: Payments are recorded in ERPNext Desk. In Accounting ▸ Sales Invoice, open ACC-SINV-2026-00001.

steps.title: Outstanding
steps.body: Outstanding Amount is QAR 1,510.00: nothing has been paid on this invoice yet.

steps.title: Open the Create menu
steps.body: Click Create.

steps.title: Create the payment
steps.body: Choose Payment.

steps.title: Filled in for you
steps.body: ERPNext filled in the customer and the invoice, and set Paid Amount to the outstanding QAR 1,510.00. If a customer pays only part, lower the Paid Amount.

steps.title: Mode of Payment
steps.body: In Mode of Payment, choose Wire Transfer.

steps.title: The bank account
steps.body: Account Paid To changed to the bank account that Wire Transfer pays into.

steps.title: Bank payments need a reference
steps.body: A payment into a bank account needs a Cheque/Reference No and Date. Without them, ERPNext refuses to save: Reference No and Reference Date is mandatory for Bank transaction.

steps.title: Reference No
steps.body: Enter the transfer reference from the customer's remittance: QNB-TRF-558214.

steps.title: Reference Date
steps.body: Set Cheque/Reference Date to today.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Click Save.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Click Submit. A Payment Entry only counts once it is submitted.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Click Yes.

steps.title: Submitted
steps.body: The payment is Submitted and allocated against ACC-SINV-2026-00001.

steps.title: Back to the invoices
steps.body: In the sidebar, click Sales Invoice.

steps.title: Paid
steps.body: ACC-SINV-2026-00001 is now Paid.

steps.title: Lower balance
steps.body: Back in DMS, Corniche Corporate Services now owes QAR 1,990.00: the QAR 1,510.00 payment came off their balance.
